notes: role=publisher: SpanPanel/panelbench publishes a Homie 5 distribution-enclosure tree (enclosure + circuits + upstream/downstream lugs + bess/pv/evse/mid children) as a SPAN-faithful test fixture, and is the reference producer our consumer-side work is developed against. PROVENANCE: the capability catalogs in src/panelbench/ebus_emitter/wire/catalogs/ are byte copies of the specification's capabilities/ at synced_commit, verified by byte comparison of all 15 files on 2026-08-06. Base profiles (wire/profiles/*.json) and the placement/addressing descriptors (wire/mapping/*.yaml) are adopted from panel-sim (electrification-bus/distribution-enclosure-simulator) rather than from the spec directly, and are hydrated against those vendored catalogs; they are not spec artifacts and so are not pinned here. Base copies are treated as READ-ONLY: every SPAN divergence is carried in the wire/profiles/span/ overlay, never as an edit to a base file, so the byte comparison above stays a valid check. PINNING RULE (following panel-sim): pin what the profiles actually publish AND that exists in the current spec catalog. charge-limit 0.1 is vendored but NOT pinned, because it is not yet composed into the EVSE profile, which still publishes the legacy `config` grab-bag; `config` is not a spec capability and is therefore also unpinned. pv/evse/mid/lugs have no standalone versioned device model upstream yet and are covered transitively as child device_types of distribution-enclosure 0.12, so they are not separately pinned; device-types 0.5 adds utility-meter, battery, inverter and meter, none of which we publish, so it changes no pin of ours. ABSTRACT UNITS: four catalog properties (soc's soe, total-energy-storage, loadup-headroom; info's nameplate-capacity) carry `unit: energy`, a dimension rather than a unit, which a publisher MUST substitute (conventions/property-json.md 0.2). That rule is prose and a constant in the spec's own tools/, so it does not travel with a vendored catalog; profile_loader rejects an unsubstituted token at load time and the conformance checker rejects one on the wire. STATE: the parent/child re-vendor is in progress on branch feat/ebus-parent-child-schema. The two-step SDK-internals workaround for transport-free construction is gone -- the tree is built with plain ebus_sdk.Device(parent=...) against ebus-sdk 0.18.0 -- and the EVSE setter is registered; the child-state cascade remains incomplete. These pins describe the schema version this repository targets; they are not a claim that every pinned capability is fully exercised yet.
